summary: A generic medium bird (crow / pigeon size, 0.36 m beak to tail, 0.62 m wingspan spread) standing on its feet… joints head_turn, head_pitch, wing_flap_l, wing_spread_l, wing_tip_l, wing_flap_r, …; options plumage, accent, breast, flight, beak, feet, …; sockets beak, back.
